documents.title: Access policy
documents.content: Production access requires hardware security keys. Temporary credentials expire after four hours. Report lost keys to the security team immediately.

documents.title: Backup operations
documents.content: Database backups run every six hours. Backup retention is thirty days. Restore drills occur on the first Monday of each month.

documents.title: Incident response
documents.content: For a production incident, page the on-call engineer. The incident commander records decisions in the incident log. Publish a review within five business days.

documents.title: Travel expenses
documents.content: Travel expenses must be submitted within fourteen days. Attach receipts for lodging and transport. The finance team reviews reimbursement requests on Fridays.

documents.title: Release process
documents.content: Every release requires a green test suite and approval from the service owner. Roll back a release when the error budget threshold is exceeded. Keep the previous image tag for recovery.

documents.title: Log retention
documents.content: Application logs are retained for seven days. Audit logs are retained for one year. Never record passwords or access tokens in logs.
